text: Accepted #createAccount awaits #validateAndFinish, but that method invokes async #finishEmailAccountAddition without await. The finish method itself awaits createAccountInBackend, and the inspected browser test separately waits until the native account appears. This is a scoped completion-boundary limit: successful verification return is not proof that account creation completed or that its rejection was caught by the verification catch. No timing failure or unhandled rejection was reproduced. This is static source and test-code inspection. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline context remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility validation ran.
title: An Account Hub verification await does not currently await backend account creation
